name: Add Provider References
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Creates one provider_references record per provider entry in the extracted providers JSON, linked to the given phone call and contact

inputs.name: extracted_providers_json
inputs.label: Extracted Providers JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of validated provider search plan objects, each with name, status, geographic_search, etc.

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the current call summary record. Used to associate the provider reference record with the call summary.
